title: Russia launches intense missile and drone assault on Ukraine
summary: The mayor of Ukraine’s capital says Kyiv was targeted by overnight drone attacks that sparked a fire in an apartment building, coming just a day after Moscow launched nearly 300 drones along with 18 ballistic and seven cruise missiles across the country. contentText: The mayor of Ukraine’s capital says Kyiv was targeted by overnight drone attacks that sparked a fire in an apartment building, coming just a day after Moscow launched nearly 300 drones along with 18 ballistic and seven cruise missiles across the country. Ukrainian officials accuse Russia of “weaponising winter” by deliberately striking energy infrastructure, leaving residents of the capital to endure intermittent power outages in freezing temperatures, as Ellen Gainsford reports.
